description: This file defines a class 'PrismaDBExceptionHandler' that provides static methods to handle database exceptions and connection errors within a proxy server context. It includes methods to determine if the database is unavailable, identify connection errors, and manage exception handling logic based on configuration.

classes.name: PrismaDBExceptionHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing database connection errors and exceptions, with logic to decide whether to allow requests or raise exceptions based on configuration and error type.

methods.name: bool should_allow_request_on_db_unavailable()
methods.description: Determines if requests should be allowed to proceed when the database is unavailable, based on a configuration setting.

methods.name: bool is_database_connection_error(e: Exception)
methods.description: Checks if a given exception is related to a database outage or connection error.

methods.name: handle_db_exception(e: Exception)
methods.description: Main method that decides whether to raise a database exception or suppress it based on the error type and configuration.
